answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Issuance tied to graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 11 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 540 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The rate is earned, not bought, so money cannot shortcut the wait. A lotus of doubt is healthy, a harbor of proof is required, and a echo of patience is the price of a clean panel. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
